legalBoundaries: Finaled records establish the displayed permit status, not current occupancy, present unit count, absence of later demolition, current as-built geometry, or whole-property compliance.
Issued, under-review, expired, and withdrawn records never establish completed work.
No result never means no property change.
failClosed: Unavailable, incomplete, truncated, ambiguous, or terms-blocked permit intelligence leaves assessor/property state unchanged and marks permit intelligence unavailable.

homeownerQuestions.finaledExplicitAdu: Public permit records indicate an ADU was completed. Is that still correct?
homeownerQuestions.activeAdu: Public records show an ADU project may be underway. What is currently on the property?

publicDisplay: Do not expose full histories or descriptions before rights/product review; a future UI may summarize 'Public permit records show...' with a source link.
